prompt_text: Cinematic establishing shot of majestic snow-covered Himalayan peaks rising into the heavens, bathed in soft celestial light. Thick mist curls around the mountain slopes, with low-hanging clouds drifting slowly across the scene. The atmosphere feels suspended in time—silent, untouched, ancient. Dramatic lighting highlights the contrast between shimmering snow and deep shadows in the rocky crevices. Camera angle is wide and elevated, capturing the vastness and stillness of the icy landscape. The mood is serene and mythic, evoking a sense of divine timelessness in a sacred, untouched world.

Cinematic close-up of Lord Shiva seated motionless at the edge of a rocky Himalayan cliff, wrapped in tiger skin with ash-smeared, ash-grey skin glowing faintly with a celestial aura. He has an extremely muscular, bodybuilder physique and sits in a meditative posture radiating divine calm. His long, jet black hair with blue undertones is coiled into a high jata, with strands flowing freely, from which the sacred Ganga flows in mid-air mist. A glowing crescent moon rests on his brow above glowing deep blue eyes and a fiery vertical third eye. His minimal ascetic attire in brown, black, and amber is adorned with sacred rudraksha beads. A serpent is coiled around his neck, and a damaru rests in his hand. The atmosphere is mythic and still, with dramatic lighting casting elongated shadows. Camera slowly pans in from a low angle, emphasizing Shiva’s towering 7-foot divine presence, with a glowing aura encircling him and the landscape silent in awe.

Cinematic close-up of Lord Shiva’s upper head and hair, focusing on his long, thick, jet black locks with blue undertones coiled into a majestic high jata. His hair rises like living serpents, glowing softly with divine energy. From the coiled matted locks, the sacred river Ganga pours gracefully into the air, sparkling with celestial light and trailing soft mist. Each droplet glistens mid-air, suspended in time. The ash-grey skin of Shiva glows subtly with a celestial hue, contrasted by the faint illumination of the crescent moon embedded on his brow. A fiery vertical third eye pulses with contained power above glowing deep blue eyes. The background is bathed in holy light with shimmering particles around the flowing water. Dramatic lighting highlights the intricate texture of his hair and the divine flow of the river. The mood is awe-inspiring and reverent. Camera angle is close and slightly low, capturing the mythic aura of Shiva’s divine crown in 16:9 frame.

Extreme cinematic close-up of Lord Shiva’s brow, capturing the glowing crescent moon resting gently on his forehead and the vertical third eye pulsing faintly with fiery orange energy. His ash-grey skin shimmers with a subtle celestial glow, illuminated by the divine aura radiating from the moon and third eye. Surrounding the forehead are ethereal cosmic symbols and swirling patterns of light, glowing softly as if alive. The texture of his ash-smeared skin and the edges of his coiled jet black hair with blue undertones are visible, framing the sacred focus point. His deep blue eyes are half-closed in meditation beneath the glowing eye of destruction. The background is a blurred swirl of sacred mist and celestial light. Dramatic lighting emphasizes the fiery core of the third eye and the soft reflection of moonlight across his skin. Mood is mythic and tense, as if creation itself holds its breath. Camera zooms from a low angle, centered on his brow, in a 16:9 cinematic frame.

Cinematic wide shot of a silent snowy cliffside in the Himalayas, bathed in ethereal twilight with dramatic lighting casting soft blue and silver hues. Snowflakes are suspended mid-air, each one sharply detailed, as if frozen in time—hovering before they can touch the ground. The scene is wrapped in mythic stillness, with no motion or wind, only the suspended particles glimmering in sacred silence. The icy landscape glows faintly, illuminated by celestial light reflecting off the snow. The ground is uneven and covered in layers of untouched snow, framed by jagged cliffs and mist rolling gently along the edges. The camera captures the scene in slow motion from a low angle, emphasizing the surreal stillness and divine suspension of time. The mood is reverent and tense, as if the world has paused in awe. No characters present, only environment and atmosphere in a 16:9 cinematic frame.

Cinematic close-up of Lord Shiva’s powerful, ash-grey hand holding a small damaru drum, mid-beat. The damaru is ornately carved with glowing symbols, and each strike sends out visible concentric waves of energy through the air—shaking the fabric of time itself. The space around the drum ripples with glowing distortions, as if the sound is bending reality. Shiva’s wrist is adorned with rudraksha beads, and his muscular forearm is smeared with sacred ash, illuminated by a divine aura. Part of his tiger skin wrap and jet black hair with blue undertones are visible in the frame. The background blurs into vibrating sacred mist, with flickers of golden and violet light pulsing in sync with the drumbeat. Dramatic lighting highlights the divine motion and casts soft shadows on his skin. Camera angle is tight and low, focusing on the damaru’s rhythm and its reality-altering effect. Mood is mythic and intense, frozen in a suspended moment of cosmic resonance, in a 16:9 cinematic frame.

Cinematic mid-shot of Lord Shiva seated in deep meditation, his muscular, ash-grey body glowing faintly under a cosmic light. One hand holds the damaru mid-motion, caught between beats. Around him, shimmering threads of time stretch outward—glowing filaments that form spirals, rings, and shifting patterns in the air. Some threads emerge bright and new with each pulse, while others dissolve into nothingness during moments of silence. Shiva's jet black hair with blue undertones floats slightly, moved by the energy around him, and the sacred Ganga continues to flow gently from his locks. His third eye pulses with faint fiery light, and the crescent moon glows softly on his brow. The background is a surreal void filled with time-ripples and vanishing echoes of past cosmic cycles. Dramatic lighting highlights the sacred rhythm of creation and destruction. The camera is angled slightly low, capturing both the stillness of Shiva and the motion of the universe around him. Mood is tense, divine, and timeless, in a 16:9 cinematic frame.

Cinematic mid-shot of Nandi, the divine bull, resting in perfect stillness beside Lord Shiva on a sacred stone platform. Nandi’s massive, extremely muscular bull body is radiant white with a silvery sheen, exuding a soft divine glow under a faint golden light. His smooth snow-white fur glistens with purity, featuring a distinctive curly tuft on his forehead and a flowing tail. Golden brown eyes with deep, serene pupils gaze forward in eternal devotion. He wears regal ornaments including a decorated saddle cloth with sacred symbols in gold, red, and white, golden anklets on all four limbs, a divine bell around his thick neck, and an ornamental marking on his forehead that glows faintly. The background shows a holy cliffside beside Shiva’s meditative form, partially framed by glowing mist. The lighting is dramatic yet gentle, casting sacred reflections on Nandi’s form. Camera is angled low and slightly off-center, creating a mythic sense of scale and reverence. Mood is peaceful yet reverent, in a 16:9 cinematic frame.

Cinematic close-up of Shiva’s massive upper body, with a grotesquely muscular serpent gliding gracefully across his shoulders. The serpent’s long, thick body shimmers with metallic emerald scales accented by dark obsidian stripes and glowing crimson undertones. Along its spine, glossy ridged scales form a mohawk-like crest that pulses faintly with arcane energy. Glowing ancient runes are embedded in its skin, trailing from neck to tail, each rune lighting up sequentially as it moves. Its fiery crimson eyes with elliptical pupils radiate intense, focused light, and its forked tongue flickers with a low, vibrating hum. A faint mist trails from its fangs, adding a supernatural haze around its coiled form. Shiva’s ash-grey skin and rudraksha beads frame the serpent’s path, while the background glows subtly with divine light and mist. Dramatic lighting highlights the serpent’s muscular texture and glowing sigils. The camera is angled low and tight, capturing the elegance and menace of the motion. Mood is tense, sacred, and alive with mystic energy, in a 16:9 cinematic frame.

Cinematic extreme close-up of the grotesquely muscular serpent’s open mouth, captured mid-hiss as it unleashes a deep, echoing sound that warps the very air around it. The serpent’s fangs glisten with a flickering aura, and a trail of mystic smoke escapes its mouth, curling into swirling void-like patterns. Its metallic emerald and obsidian-striped scales glow faintly with crimson undertones, and the embedded ancient runes along its spine pulse with a red shimmer. The forked tongue flickers outward, vibrating with a low hum that distorts the space around it. The serpent’s fiery crimson eyes with vertical pupils burn with intensity, casting light onto the surrounding mist. The background trembles with shimmering distortions, as if sound itself is bending reality. Dramatic lighting highlights the textures of the scales, fangs, and smoke. Camera zooms in from a low angle focused directly on the serpent’s mouth, emphasizing the void-like tension of the moment. Mood is dark, sacred, and mythic, frozen in cosmic suspense, captured in a 16:9 cinematic frame.

Cinematic mid-shot of Lord Shiva seated in deep meditation, his ash-grey, extremely muscular body glowing with divine intensity as his eyes flash open. His glowing deep blue eyes blaze with galactic light, while his fiery vertical third eye ignites with a burst of cosmic energy. Storm clouds swirl behind him, and the sky darkens, splitting open with celestial lightning as galaxies ripple outward from his gaze. His long, jet black hair with blue undertones flows upward, reacting to the unleashed power. The sacred Ganga pours forcefully from his coiled jata, glimmering with stardust. Around his neck, the serpent tenses, glowing runes flaring. The crescent moon on his brow shines like a beacon. Shiva’s tiger skin wrap flutters in the rising wind, and his rudraksha beads shimmer with vibrating light. The air crackles with divine tension. The camera captures him from a low angle, emphasizing his towering form against the cosmic storm. Lighting is dramatic and volatile. Mood is mythic, tense, and transcendent, in a 16:9 cinematic frame.

Cinematic wide shot of Lord Shiva seated once again in complete stillness atop a snow-dusted Himalayan cliff. His glowing deep blue eyes have gently closed, and his fiery third eye dims to a soft ember. The storm behind him has vanished; galaxies that once rippled through space now recede into quiet nothingness. His long, jet black hair with blue undertones settles back into its high jata, the Ganga flowing in a calm, gentle stream. The serpent around his neck coils loosely, its glow fading to a faint shimmer. The crescent moon on his brow radiates a soft silver glow, while the rudraksha beads and tiger skin wrap lie motionless against his extremely muscular, ash-grey form. Snowflakes begin to fall again, gently settling around him. The sacred landscape returns to tranquil silence, bathed in pale light. Camera captures the moment from a low, reverent angle, slowly pulling back. Mood is peaceful, divine, and still. Lighting is soft and subdued, framed in a mythic 16:9 composition.
